cards.english_title: Lawmakers summon Nvidia’s former CEO after spy allegations
cards.korean_desc: 젠슨 황은 2026년 11월 12일 사임했다 사임은 중국 간첩 의혹 여성과의 불륜 보도 뒤였다 이사회는 최고재무책임자 콜레트 크레스를 임시 CEO로 임명했다 미국 의원들은 12월 비공개 질문을 계획한다

cards.english_title: Europe wants a peace-talk seat, but cannot choose one voice
cards.korean_desc: 유럽 정상들은 2026년 11월 13일 더블린에서 대표 문제를 논의했다 그들은 미국과 러시아가 유럽 안보를 대신 정할까 걱정한다 이탈리아 멜로니는 한 대표를 지지하지만 작은 국가는 배제를 걱정한다 미국 특사들은 유럽이 다음 협상에 참여한다고 했지만 대표는 없다
cards.english_desc: European leaders debated representation at Ukraine peace talks in Dublin on November 13, 2026. They fear Washington and Moscow could decide Europe’s security without European input. Italy’s Giorgia Meloni supports one envoy, while smaller states fear exclusion. U.S. envoys said Europeans would join the next round, but no representative is chosen.
cards.hook: Europe wants a seat but lacks one voice.
cards.takeaway_english: Europe may join the next talks, but its representative remains unsettled.
cards.takeaway_korean: 유럽은 다음 협상에 참여할 수 있지만 대표는 정해지지 않았다

why_it_matters.english: The talks may shape Ukraine’s future security.
why_it_matters.korean: 협상은 우크라이나의 미래 안보를 정할 수 있다

why_it_matters.english: European countries would live with the settlement’s consequences.
why_it_matters.korean: 유럽 국가들은 합의의 결과를 감당하게 된다

parties.label: European governments
parties.english: They want representation in talks involving Russia, Ukraine and the United States.
parties.korean: 그들은 러시아 우크라이나 미국과의 협상에 참여하려 한다

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: Ukraine wants European backing during negotiations.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: Russia opposes direct European involvement in the talks.

views.label: Supporters of one envoy
views.english: A single representative could give Europe a clear and authoritative voice.
views.korean: 단일 대표는 유럽에 분명한 권위 있는 목소리를 줄 수 있다

views.label: Critics of one envoy
views.english: One envoy could leave smaller European countries outside the decision-making process.
views.korean: 한 명의 대표는 작은 유럽 국가들을 배제할 수 있다

disagree.english: Europe includes several overlapping groups, so one representative may not reflect every government.
disagree.korean: 유럽에는 여러 조직이 있어 한 대표가 모두를 대변하기 어렵다

cards.english_title: Spain’s Sánchez struggles to rally a disillusioned left
cards.korean_desc: 스페인 총리 페드로 산체스는 2026년 11월 29일 유권자를 만난다 그는 주거 분노가 좌파 유권자를 모으길 바랐다 퇴거 임대료 공공서비스 시위 뒤 전국 파업이 이어졌다 여론조사는 사회당을 26퍼센트에서 29퍼센트로 본다
cards.english_desc: Spain’s Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez faces voters on November 29, 2026. He hoped anger over housing would bring left-wing voters together. A nationwide strike followed protests over evictions, rents and public services. Polls still place the Socialists near 26% to 29%, while a right-wing alliance remains possible.
cards.hook: Sánchez faces a divided left before November 29.
cards.takeaway_english: Housing anger has become both Sánchez’s strongest issue and his political problem.
cards.takeaway_korean: 주거 분노는 산체스의 가장 강한 쟁점이자 문제다

why_it_matters.english: The election could change housing protections and social policy.
why_it_matters.korean: 선거는 주거 보호와 사회 정책을 바꿀 수 있다

why_it_matters.english: A right-wing alliance could shape migration and deregulation policy.
why_it_matters.korean: 우파 연합은 이민과 규제 정책을 바꿀 수 있다

parties.label: Pedro Sánchez
parties.english: He called a snap election, hoping housing anger would unite the left.
parties.korean: 그는 주거 분노가 좌파를 묶길 바라며 조기선거를 불렀다

parties.label: Left-wing voters
parties.english: Many are angry about housing, public services and the government’s record.
parties.korean: 많은 유권자는 주거와 공공서비스에 화가 났다

parties.label: People’s Party and Vox
parties.english: Their possible alliance is seen as the likely next government.
parties.korean: 두 정당의 연합이 다음 정부로 예상된다

views.label: Sánchez’s Socialists
views.english: They say a People’s Party–Vox government would threaten social rights.
views.korean: 그들은 국민당 복스 정부가 사회적 권리를 위협한다고 말한다

views.label: Left activists
views.english: They say the Socialists have delivered too little and voting alone is insufficient.
views.korean: 그들은 사회당의 성과가 부족하고 투표만으로는 충분하지 않다고 말한다

disagree.english: Supporters of Sánchez argue tactical voting could still stop the right from taking power.

cards.english_desc: The waterway matters because it carries major global energy shipments. The Revolutionary Guards said the vessel used an unauthorized route and exploded. At least 10 ships were hit during November’s first 10 days.

cards.takeaway_english: More incidents could threaten the recent recovery of shipping through Hormuz.
cards.takeaway_korean: 추가 사건은 호르무즈 운항 회복을 위협할 수 있다

why_it_matters.english: The Strait of Hormuz is vital for global shipping.

why_it_matters.english: Attacks can affect fuel prices and deliveries.
why_it_matters.korean: 공격은 연료 가격과 배송에 영향을 줄 수 있다

parties.label: Global energy markets

views.label: Shipping observers

cards.english_title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after spy scandal
cards.korean_desc: 젠슨 황은 2026년 11월 12일 엔비디아 CEO에서 사임했다 그의 퇴진은 중국 간첩 의혹 여성과의 불륜 보도 뒤였다 이사회는 CFO 콜레트 크레스를 임시 CEO로 정하고 후임을 찾기 시작했다 사임 뒤 엔비디아 주가는 개장 전 거래에서 10퍼센트 떨어졌다
cards.english_desc: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO on November 12, 2026. His departure followed reports of affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China. The board named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO and began searching for a successor. Nvidia shares fell 10% in premarket trading after the resignation.
cards.hook: Nvidia’s CEO resigned after two affair reports.
cards.korean_hook: 엔비디아 CEO가 불륜 보도 뒤 사임했다
cards.takeaway_english: Nvidia now faces a leadership search while governments watch its technology links closely.
cards.takeaway_korean: 엔비디아는 기술 관계를 지켜보는 가운데 새 지도자를 찾아야 한다

why_it_matters.english: Nvidia’s chips power much of the artificial-intelligence industry.
why_it_matters.korean: 엔비디아 칩은 인공지능 산업의 많은 부분을 움직인다

why_it_matters.english: The resignation immediately affected Nvidia’s share price.
why_it_matters.korean: 사임은 엔비디아 주가에 즉시 영향을 줬다

parties.label: Jensen Huang
parties.english: He left Nvidia after 33 years leading the company he co-founded.
parties.korean: 그는 공동 창업한 회사를 33년 이끈 뒤 떠났다

parties.label: Colette Kress
parties.english: She became interim CEO while remaining chief financial officer.
parties.korean: 그녀는 최고재무책임자를 유지하며 임시 CEO가 됐다

parties.label: Nvidia
parties.english: The company must search for a permanent replacement during an AI boom.
parties.korean: 회사는 인공지능 붐 속에서 정식 후임을 찾아야 한다

views.label: Nvidia’s board
views.english: The board says operations and the product roadmap should continue without interruption.
views.korean: 이사회는 운영과 제품 계획이 중단 없이 계속된다고 말한다

views.label: U.S. security critics
views.english: They say the scandal raises questions about chip exports and national security.

sources.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy scandal

sentences.english: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO on November 12, 2026.
